item.title: Episode 005 with Jaycie Randall
item.itunes:title: Episode 005 with Jaycie Randall
item.description: In this episode, I get to chat with my friend Jaycie Randall. We discuss various subjects such as goals, ambitions, growing up and maturing in a small town, waking up, the present moment, difficult conversations in a relationship, allergies, expressing emotions, branching from plateus, planning for the future and 30 day lents. Jaycies incredible emotional intelligence and broad ability to remain aware and wise of her present moment in each interaction she has... brings much comfort and 'now' to our chats. We talked for hours prior to this about life and it's beautiful but presently unraveling mysteries. I hope you enjoy our talk as much as I did.
